files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ActionBlock
files.Summary: A block whose objective can take more than one frame, and which therefore reports rather than simply running to completion.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ActionResult
files.Summary: What an action reports about the objective it was given: still pending, finished having met it, or finished having failed to meet it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ActivateObjectBlock
files.Summary: What Object.Activate() and Object.Activate(name) build: activates the object the script runs on, or one the script created.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AdapterAdmission
files.Summary: The package and version admission table for extension blocks and optional adapters.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AdapterRegistration
files.Summary: One extension block type an adapter registered, with the Unity package and minimum version that type needs.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AimedLookAtBuilder
files.Summary: A facing whose up direction has been named. It converts to a block and takes no further clause.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Anchor
files.Summary: One of the nine reserved HUD regions a Panel.Place call can occupy: four corners, four edges, and the centre.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ApplicationObservation
files.Summary: Which of the five application observations a runner is delivering: what Unity reported about the application as a whole, rather than about one object.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ArithmeticOperator
files.Summary: Which arithmetic a performs.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Asset<T>
files.Summary: A handle to one asset input of a script. Returned by Bind.Asset at build time; reading the asset itself is an instance read, because the value belongs to the object and not to the script type.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetAttribute
files.Summary: Declares an asset input whose handle is assigned before Build, in declaration order.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetFactory
files.Summary: The Asset surface inside Build(): starts and ends content acquisitions. Unity owns the asset. LunyScript owns the attempt, the owner-acquisition, and consumer retention.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetGateway
files.Summary: Owns in-flight Asset.Load attempts and owner-acquisition records for one . Bound Inspector loads complete from the instance's already resolved input. Resources loads go through . Script code never sees a Task or an exception type; AGENTS.md rules 50 and 51.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetInput
files.Summary: One declared asset input with its type forgotten: what a surface takes when it accepts an input of any Unity type, such as the camera rig a view renders.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetInputAssignment
files.Summary: One row of the declared-input table a host component serializes: the name of a declared input and the asset this object assigns to it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetLoadBlock
files.Summary: What Asset.Load(source).As(handle) builds: starts one asynchronous content acquisition bound to an operation handle. Completion yields an owned typed asset on that handle, or a classified failure. Failure does not fall through to an asset placeholder.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetLoadBuilder
files.Summary: What Asset.Load(source) returns: an unfinished acquisition that becomes a block when binds the operation handle. An unbound Load is refused when Build() finishes.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetPlaceholderFactory
files.Summary: Builds the asset placeholder for one declared asset type.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetPlaceholderSource
files.Summary: Which configuration named the asset placeholder a type resolves to.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetPlaceholders
files.Summary: The asset placeholder every asset type falls back to when an input of that type is left unassigned, and the two ways one is configured.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetProvider
files.Summary: Which provider finds an asset that a script names.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetReleaseBlock
files.Summary: What Asset.Release(acquisition) builds: relinquishes this owner's acquisition. Bound consumers retain content they still need. Release does not destroy them and does not promise immediate physical reclamation.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetSource<T>
files.Summary: One provider-qualified place a declared asset input loads from when the host assigns nothing.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AssetSource
files.Summary: Names the provider-qualified sources a declared asset input can load from.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AudioFactory
files.Summary: The Audio surface inside Build(): one-shot play, bound source control, and named mixer writes. It hides UnityEngine.AudioSource inside a Script the same way Transform hides UnityEngine.Transform.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AudioGateway
files.Summary: The runner-owned audio service: pooled one-shot voices, named bound-source control, and mixer writes. Bound playback on the object a script runs on lives on instead.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AudioListenerHandle
files.Summary: What Audio.Listener returns.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AudioListenerTargetBuilder
files.Summary: What Audio.Listener.SetTarget(target) returns.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AudioMixerHandle
files.Summary: What Audio.Mixer(mixer) returns: named exposed-parameter writes.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AudioPlacedOneShotBuilder
files.Summary: A one-shot whose placement has been named. It converts to a block and takes no further placement clause.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AudioPlayOneShotBuilder
files.Summary: What Audio.PlayOneShot(clip) returns: a 2D one-shot, or one placement.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AudioSourceHandle
files.Summary: What Audio.For(source) returns: bound-source control on that object.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AudioVoice
files.Summary: What Audio.Voice(name) returns: one tracked one-shot.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AudioVoiceVolumeBuilder
files.Summary: What voice.SetVolume(value) returns.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.AudioWatchBuilder
files.Summary: What When.Audio(voice) returns. Each method registers blocks for one end of that tracked playback.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.BindFactory
files.Summary: The Bind surface inside Build(): declares the assets a script needs and hands back the typed handles that read them.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Block
files.Summary: One step of behaviour in a script. A block object is created once, when its script type is built, and is then shared by every object running that script; the per-object state it reads and writes lives in slots on the passed to .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.BodyFactory
files.Summary: The Body surface inside Build(): observations of what physics actually did to the object this script runs on.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CameraFactory
files.Summary: The Camera surface inside Build(): what one camera rig tracks. It hides UnityEngine.Camera inside a Script the same way Transform hides UnityEngine.Transform.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CameraGateway
files.Summary: The core's one entry point to the camera. Owns the , passes each authored operation to it, and reports a refused one once.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CameraOperationResult
files.Summary: What happened when the camera gateway asked its provider to do something.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CameraRigBuilder
files.Summary: What Camera.For(rig) returns: the rig's two tracking targets and its target group.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CameraTargetOperation
files.Summary: What one target-group operation does to a camera rig's group of tracked objects.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CameraTargetsBuilder
files.Summary: What Camera.For(rig).Targets returns: the five operations on a rig's group of tracked objects.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CameraTracking
files.Summary: Which of a camera rig's two tracking targets an operation writes.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ChooseBiasedBuilder
files.Summary: A Choose chain that already has Bias. Optional follows.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ChooseBuilder
files.Summary: What Choose(subject) returns. Its one call, , names the scored options.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ChooseCompleteBuilder
files.Summary: A Choose chain that has both Bias and Hold. Used as a block it starts the selector.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ChooseHeldBuilder
files.Summary: A Choose chain that already has Hold. Optional follows.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ChooseHighestBuilder
files.Summary: A Choose(subject).Highest(...) chain. Optional and follow; used as a block it starts the selector.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Cinemachine.CinemachineCameraProvider
files.Summary: The camera backend that drives Cinemachine. The one place in the product that references the Cinemachine package.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CloudFactory
files.Summary: The Cloud surface inside Build(): builds the start blocks for Cloud Save. A start block enqueues and returns in the same call; the outcome arrives through When.Cloud(key). AGENTS.md rule 50.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CloudSaveGateway
files.Summary: Owns every in-flight Cloud Save request for one , keyed by the save key. Signs in when the first request arrives, queues requests made before the service is ready, coalesces duplicates, polls each operation once per frame, and classifies every failure once into an . No script and no block ever sees a Task or an exception type; AGENTS.md section 12.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CloudWatchBuilder
files.Summary: What When.Cloud(key) returns: registers blocks against one key's Cloud Save outcomes. Each registration declares a hidden counter-shadow variable at build time and is polled once per frame after On.FrameUpdate, the same shape When.Var(x).Changed has.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CollectionRead
files.Summary: A typed read of one collection entry: either At(index) or the current ForEach item. Each use reads the entry addressed by that expression, so a replacement of the current element is visible to the next read in the same body.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ComparisonOperator
files.Summary: Which comparison a performs.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CompilationFacts
files.Summary: What the compiler was told when this assembly was built. Read by tests and by the release gate, so that a claim about release behaviour can name the compilation it was measured in.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ConditionBlock
files.Summary: A block that answers true or false for one object. Passed to If(...) and combined with &, | and !.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CreateObjectBlock
files.Summary: What Object.Create(name) builds: creates a new, empty, active object owned by the instance that runs this block, and records it in the owned-object slot the build assigned to that name.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.CursorInputFactory
files.Summary: What Input.Cursor returns: lock and visibility as two independent writes on the machine cursor. Four local players share one cursor; this surface is not on Input.ForPlayer.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DeactivateObjectBlock
files.Summary: What Object.Deactivate() and Object.Deactivate(name) build: deactivates the object the script runs on, or one the script created.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DefineFactory
files.Summary: The Define surface inside Build(): declares a script's variables with the author spelling Round 06 settled, and hands back the typed handles the blocks are built from.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DespawnObjectBlock
files.Summary: What Object.Despawn() and Object.Despawn(name) build: ends the object the script runs on, or destroys one the script created.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DiagnosticBuffer
files.Summary: Fixed-capacity, ordered storage shared by console and trace readers.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DiagnosticCatalog
files.Summary: Immutable catalog for one built program.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DiagnosticCommand
files.Summary: Caller-owned receipt. Terminal results survive target closure and are never replayed.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DiagnosticCommandState
files.Summary: Admission and terminal application states for one submitted command.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DiagnosticFault
files.Summary: Observed contained error or failed outer boundary, separate from enabled state.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DiagnosticIdentity
files.Summary: Identifies one lifetime independently of pooled object reuse.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DiagnosticNode
files.Summary: Immutable declaration metadata; never contains a live block or delegate.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DiagnosticProtocol
files.Summary: Local diagnostics protocol version. Current snapshots and optional action records are separate observations.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DiagnosticRecordKind
files.Summary: The observation represented by a console or trace record.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DiagnosticSnapshot
files.Summary: Caller-owned current state from an idle main-thread boundary, never execution history.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DiagnosticTrace
files.Summary: Explicit action capture for one instance lifetime. Disposal changes no script state.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DiagnosticValue
files.Summary: A typed diagnostic value. Text is a caller-owned managed representation.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.DiagnosticVariable
files.Summary: One immutable declared variable, including whether it is internal storage.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.EditorScript
files.Summary: The editor entry: a subclass whose Build() composes blocks that run in an EditorScriptSession. Game scripts subclass instead. A concrete identifies the editor role without an attribute.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Elapsed
files.Summary: An elapsed duration written with a unit constructor: Seconds(1), Milliseconds(500), Minutes(2) or Hours(1).

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.EnumSlot
files.Summary: Where one declared C# enum variable lives on every instance of a program. Allocated at build time and never at run time.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.EnumValueBlock
files.Summary: The root of every enum expression: something that produces an integer code when the block holding it runs.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.FakeAssetLoadProvider
files.Summary: An in-memory asset-load backend for tests: keys map to objects a test registered, a missing key fails as NotFound, and a registered object of another type fails as Denied. No Resources folder is required. AGENTS.md rule 52's shape applied to assets.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.FakeCameraProvider.TargetGroupEntry
files.Summary: One object in a rig's target group, with the weight and radius it was given.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.FakeCameraProvider
files.Summary: A camera backend that records what it was asked to do, with no Cinemachine package, no camera and no scene.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.FakeInputProvider
files.Summary: An input backend that holds its actions and their values in memory, with no device, no window and no Input System package.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.FakeNetworkProvider
files.Summary: A netcode backend that runs entirely in this process, with no network, no Editor and no Netcode for GameObjects. Two instances are paired with and each one's sends arrive in the other's queues.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.FileCloudSaveProvider
files.Summary: The file-based Cloud Save provider: one file per key, under a directory the caller names. A first-class part of the product, not a test fixture; AGENTS.md rule 52. It is how every failure branch is tested without a network, and what makes the automated suite runnable with no credentials.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Flag
files.Summary: A boolean literal and the type argument of a Var<Flag>.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.FlagBindBuilder
files.Summary: What Bind.Flag returns. It converts to no handle; Shared is required.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.FlagDefineBuilder
files.Summary: What Define.Flag returns: an object-local flag unless Shared is called.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.FlagSlot
files.Summary: Where one Flag variable lives on every instance of a program. Allocated at build time and never at run time.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.FlagValueBlock
files.Summary: A block that produces a Flag for one object: a variable read or a literal.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ForEachListBuilder<T>
files.Summary: What ForEach(list) returns. Its only method is .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ForEachMapBuilder<TKey, TValue>
files.Summary: What ForEach(map) returns. Its only method is .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.GameObjectHost
files.Summary: The runtime for a GameObject, as the blocks see it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.GateCategory
files.Summary: Systems a named gate may suppress for every script on the runner. Only input and camera exist as mute-able gateways in this version.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.GateFactory
files.Summary: The Gate surface: named, nested, runner-wide masks of suppressed categories.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IAssetLoadOperation
files.Summary: A load in flight. Adds the loaded object to . The object is meaningful only once the operation completed successfully.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IAssetLoadProvider
files.Summary: What an asset-load backend provides to : one load of a provider-qualified key, returned as an operation the gateway polls once per frame. Script code never sees this type; it sees Asset.Load and When.Operation.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ICameraProvider
files.Summary: What a camera backend provides to the : choosing which rig a view renders, sizing that view, and writing a rig's tracking targets. Script code never sees this type; it sees the View and Camera surfaces.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ICloudLoadOperation
files.Summary: A load in flight. Adds the loaded value to ; the value is meaningful only once the operation completed successfully.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ICloudSaveProvider
files.Summary: What a Cloud Save backend provides to the : sign-in, a save and a load, each returned as an operation the gateway polls once per frame. Script code never sees this type; it sees start blocks and outcome events. AGENTS.md section 12.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IInputActionHandle
files.Summary: The one thing every input action handle has in common: whether Build() produced it, and where its declaration sits in the program.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IInputProvider
files.Summary: What an input backend provides to the : the resolution of a declared action name to something the backend can read, the four value reads, the three per-frame occurrence tests, and interactive rebind start, cancel and poll. Script code never sees this type; it sees the Input surface, When.Input and handle.Rebind().As. Cursor lock and visibility are not on this interface.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.INetworkProvider
files.Summary: What a netcode backend provides to the : a session to start and end, the connection facts a script is allowed to read, and two queues the gateway drains once per tick. Script code never sees this type; it sees the Net and Sync surfaces. AGENTS.md rule 49.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IPackageVersionSource
files.Summary: Answers which Unity package versions this project currently has installed. Adapter admission queries it at spawn, never per frame.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IScriptAssetInputs
files.Summary: The part of a host that carries the assets an author assigned to one object, so that two objects running the same script can hold different assets.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IScriptHost
files.Summary: The object a script runs on, as the blocks see it. Blocks reach the object through this interface and never through a GameObject, a Transform or a Component.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IScriptHostCapabilities
files.Summary: Optional explicit host capability declaration. Legacy hosts remain runtime hosts.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IScriptNode
files.Summary: Build-time requirements and child declarations for actions and expressions.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IScriptObjectLifetime
files.Summary: The part of a host that can activate, deactivate, create and destroy objects. A host that provides it declares by implementing this interface; a host that does not cannot run a script containing an Object block, and the spawn is refused with a message naming the missing service.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IScriptObjectSpawner
files.Summary: The part of a host that can produce a new object from a prefab. A host that provides it declares by implementing this interface; a host that does not cannot run a script containing an Object.Spawn block, and the spawn of that script is refused with a message naming the missing service.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IScriptTrackingTarget
files.Summary: The one thing a camera needs from the object a script runs on: something it can be told to follow or aim at. A host that can supply one implements this interface.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IUiElementHandle
files.Summary: The one thing every UI element handle has in common: whether Build() produced it, and where its declaration sits in the program.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IfBuilder
files.Summary: What If(condition) returns. Its only method is , so a condition without a consequence does not compile.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.IfThenBuilder
files.Summary: What If(condition).Then(...) returns: either add an or use it as a block, which the implicit conversion does.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Input.InputSystemProvider
files.Summary: The input backend that reads Unity's Input System. The one place in the product that references that package.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InputActionResolution
files.Summary: Why an input action declaration did or did not resolve to a configured action.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InputButton
files.Summary: A handle to one pressed-or-not action of one local player. Returned by Input.ForPlayer(player).Button(name) at build time; the members on it build blocks.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InputFactory
files.Summary: The Input surface inside Build(): names the local player whose actions this script reads. It hides UnityEngine.Input inside a Script the same way Transform hides UnityEngine.Transform.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InputGateway
files.Summary: The core's one entry point to player input. Owns the , resolves each program's declared actions once, and answers the value reads and the occurrence tests the input blocks make.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InputNumber
files.Summary: A handle to one single-axis action of one local player. Returned by Input.ForPlayer(player).Number(name) at build time.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InputPhase
files.Summary: The three occurrences one input action reports, which are the three the accepted design names.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InputRebindBuilder
files.Summary: What handle.Rebind() returns. Bind it with .As(operation) before Build() returns, or Finish refuses the chain naming this type and the authored line.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InputRebindPoll
files.Summary: What polling one in-flight rebind capture reports. Must allocate nothing while pending.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InputRebindStart
files.Summary: Whether an interactive rebind capture started, and why not when it did not.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InputValueKind
files.Summary: What one input action produces. The four kinds are the ones the accepted design names: Button, Number, Vector2 and Vector3.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InputVector2
files.Summary: A handle to one two-axis action of one local player. Returned by Input.ForPlayer(player).Vector2(name) at build time.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InputVector3
files.Summary: A handle to one three-axis action of one local player. Returned by Input.ForPlayer(player).Vector3(name) at build time.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InputWatchBuilder
files.Summary: What When.Input(action) returns. Its three methods register the blocks that run on a frame where the action reported that occurrence.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.InstanceLayout
files.Summary: How many slots of each kind one instance of a program owns, and what value each slot starts from. Built once per script type and never changed afterwards.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LifetimeRequest
files.Summary: What an authored Object.Activate(), Object.Deactivate() or Object.Despawn() asked the runner to do to the object a script runs on.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ListDefineBuilder<T>
files.Summary: What Define.List returns: an empty list of the declared capacity.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ListHandle<T>
files.Summary: A handle to one fixed-capacity list declared with Define.List<T>. Occupancy starts at zero. The C# type is not List<T>, because that name collides with System.Collections.Generic.List.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LookAtBuilder
files.Summary: What LookAt returns: the facing, about the world up unless names another direction.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LunyScriptBehaviour
files.Summary: Assigns one GameObject to one script type. This is the component a user adds; the script is named by an explicit field rather than by a type name written as a string.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LunyScriptContactBehaviour
files.Summary: Unity physics callbacks for one managed object whose script declared at least one of the six contact events. adds this component only in that case, so an object whose script declares none of them is not subscribed.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LunyScriptContractException
files.Summary: Thrown when LunyScript observes that the lifecycle ownership contract was broken: the object running a script was destroyed, reparented or otherwise changed by native Unity API rather than by a LunyScript block.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LunyScriptDriverBehaviour
files.Summary: Ticks one once per frame, and sweeps instances whose object a scene unload took away. Lives on a hidden object that creates; a user never adds this component.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LunyScriptException
files.Summary: The root of every exception LunyScript throws. Catch this to catch everything the product raised and nothing else.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LunyScriptInternalException
files.Summary: Thrown when LunyScript's own invariant was broken on a path a user cannot reach: a null or an impossible value inside the product's internals.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LunyScriptLog
files.Summary: The one place LunyScript writes to the Unity console. Unity log lines are formatted here; the LunyScript console reads the retained structured fields.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LunyScriptLogAreas
files.Summary: The area names the product's own log records carry, so that a reader and a debugging window see the same set of words rather than one spelling per call site.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LunyScriptLogRecord
files.Summary: One thing LunyScript has to say, as structured fields rather than as a finished string.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LunyScriptLogSeverity
files.Summary: How serious one LunyScript log record is.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LunyScriptRuntime
files.Summary: Holds the one that components share, and the hidden object that ticks it once per frame.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.LunyScriptUsageException
files.Summary: Thrown when script code asks LunyScript for something the API does not offer: a C# if around a condition block, an arithmetic operator on a text variable, a builder finished twice.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MapDefineBuilder<TKey, TValue>
files.Summary: What Define.Map returns: an empty map of the declared capacity.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MapHandle<TKey, TValue>
files.Summary: A handle to one fixed-capacity map declared with Define.Map<TKey, TValue>. Occupancy starts at zero. Existing-key assignment replaces the value and keeps insertion order.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MathFactory
files.Summary: The core numeric functions, written as Math.Abs(...) inside a script's Build(). Every member returns an expression that is evaluated each time the block holding it runs; none of them writes anything.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionDisplacementBuilder
files.Summary: What Motion.MoveBy returns: a displacement along the object's own axes unless is written.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionFaceTowardsBuilder
files.Summary: What Motion.FaceTowards returns. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionFaceTowardsRatedBuilder
files.Summary: A FaceTowards whose rate has been named. Converts to a block.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionFactory
files.Summary: The Motion surface inside Build(): component-directed movement, force and relocation for the object a script runs on.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionForceBuilder
files.Summary: What Motion.AddForce and Motion.AddImpulse return: object-local axes unless is written.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionMechanism
files.Summary: Which movement component selected.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionMoveToAtSpeedBuilder
files.Summary: A MoveTo whose rate has been named. Converts to a block.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionMoveToBuilder
files.Summary: What Motion.MoveTo returns. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionMoveToDurationBuilder
files.Summary: A MoveTo whose duration amount has been named. Incomplete until an elapsed unit.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionRotateToBuilder
files.Summary: What Motion.RotateTo returns. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionRotateToDurationBuilder
files.Summary: A RotateTo whose duration amount has been named. Incomplete until an elapsed unit.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionRotateToRatedBuilder
files.Summary: A RotateTo whose rate has been named. Converts to a block.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionTeleportBuilder
files.Summary: What Motion.TeleportTo returns: a position write, or first.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionTeleportOrientedBuilder
files.Summary: A teleport whose orientation has been named. Converts to a block.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.MotionVelocityBuilder
files.Summary: What Motion.SetVelocity returns: object-local axes unless is written.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NetFactory
files.Summary: The Net surface a script reads the session through: who has authority, whether there is a session, how many peers, how far behind a value is, and the one way to ask the authority to do something.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NetSendFactory
files.Summary: Net.Send: the one way a peer without authority asks the authority to do something.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Netcode.LunyScriptNetworkBehaviour
files.Summary: Binds the script instance on this object to the object's network identity, so that its synchronised variables and its messages reach the same object on every peer.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Netcode.NgoNetworkProvider
files.Summary: The Netcode for GameObjects backend for : starts and ends a session on NetworkManager, answers the connection facts a script may read, and carries LunyScript's messages and synchronised variables over one named message channel.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NetworkGateway
files.Summary: The core's one entry point to netcode. Owns the , refuses the session calls that are a user mistake, and drains the provider's two queues once per tick. AGENTS.md rules 44 to 49.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NetworkMessage
files.Summary: One received message: which object it is about, which message it is, and which peer sent it. Sender is carried because rule 45 forbids hiding ownership, and a script that reacts to a message usually needs to know who asked.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NetworkValue
files.Summary: One value crossing the network, typed rather than boxed.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NetworkValueKind
files.Summary: Which field of a carries the value.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NetworkVariableUpdate
files.Summary: One received variable update: which object, which synchronised variable, and the value.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NodeDescription
files.Summary: Collects named child nodes while building immutable program metadata.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Number
files.Summary: A numeric literal and the type argument of a Var<Number>.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NumberBindBuilder
files.Summary: What Bind.Number returns. It converts to no handle; Shared is required.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NumberDefineBuilder
files.Summary: What Define.Number returns: an object-local number unless Shared is called.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NumberFunction
files.Summary: Which function a evaluates, and which write a NumberMutateBlock applies to its slot.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NumberSlot
files.Summary: Where one Number variable lives on every instance of a program. Allocated at build time and never at run time.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NumberState
files.Summary: Which question a asks about one number.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.NumberValueBlock
files.Summary: A block that produces a Number for one object: a variable read, a literal, or an arithmetic expression over other value blocks.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ObjectLifetimeFactory
files.Summary: The Object surface inside Build(): builds the blocks that create, activate, deactivate and end objects this script owns.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.OnApplicationFactory
files.Summary: On.Application: what Unity reported about the application as a whole, rather than about one object.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.OnAuthorityFactory
files.Summary: On.Authority: the two events a script gets when this peer starts or stops being the one that may write the object's synchronised variables.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.OnEditorFactory
files.Summary: The On surface on : Ready, Created, Enabled, Disabled, Despawned, and EditorUpdate. Frame, physics and application events live on .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.OnFactory
files.Summary: The On surface inside Build(): registers blocks against the events the runner raises.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Operation<T>
files.Summary: A typed operation handle. The attempt, generation, deadline and classified outcome are the same surface as . A typed payload is filled by a later family that owns the result type.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Operation
files.Summary: A handle to one observable attempt. Declared with Operation.Define(nameof(X)) inside Build(); family start blocks bind it with .As(handle).

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.OperationFactory
files.Summary: The Operation surface inside Build(): declares a handle with one observable attempt at a time.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.OperationWatchBuilder
files.Summary: What When.Operation(handle) returns: registers blocks against one attempt's classified outcomes. Each registration declares a hidden counter-shadow variable at build time and is polled once per frame after On.FrameUpdate, the same shape When.Cloud(key).Saved has.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.OrbitPointBuilder
files.Summary: What RotateAround(point) returns: the pivot, waiting for the rotation to apply about it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.OrbitRotationBuilder
files.Summary: What RotateAround(point).By(rotation) returns: the orbit, waiting for the one thing a caller has to say about it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.OtherFactory
files.Summary: The Other surface inside Build(): the other collider of the contact event currently running.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.PanelCloseBuilder
files.Summary: What Panel.Close(menu) returns. ForPlayer is required.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.PanelFactory
files.Summary: The Panel surface inside Build(): typed binds, Place of a UXML fragment, and Open/Close of a menu. It hides PanelRenderer inside a Script the same way Transform hides UnityEngine.Transform.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.PanelHandle
files.Summary: What Panel.For(panel) returns: typed elements on that panel's document.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.PanelOpenBuilder
files.Summary: What Panel.Open(menu) returns. ForPlayer is required.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.PlaceAtBuilder
files.Summary: What Panel.Place(uxml) returns. At is required; In is optional.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Platform.AllocatingTextSink
files.Summary: The runtime for a text variable declared with allocating storage: a bounded UTF-8 buffer on the heap, allowed to allocate when the content changes and not when the same content is written again.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Platform.GameClockRules
files.Summary: What a time scale is allowed to be, and the one refusal message every caller that checks it raises.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Platform.IAsyncOperation
files.Summary: One in-flight request owned by the services gateway. Script code never sees this type; it sees a status variable and an outcome event. This interface exists so that the gateway has exactly one place that knows how asynchronous work is represented.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Platform.IDocumentCodec
files.Summary: The only place LunyScript converts between a saved document and the values in a script's variable slots. The cloud-save provider and any future file provider both go through it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Platform.IGameClock
files.Summary: A clock that drives a running game, so it carries the game's time scale and can be paused as well as read. Time.Scale, Time.IsPaused, Time.SetScale, Time.Pause and Time.Resume reach the clock through this interface.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Platform.IRandomSource
files.Summary: The only place LunyScript draws a random number. A script's randomness is seeded per run so that a failing test can be replayed with the seed it printed.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Platform.ITextSink
files.Summary: The only place LunyScript turns a value into text. A text variable writes through this interface, so no block formats a managed string of its own.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Platform.ITimeSource
files.Summary: The only place LunyScript reads the passage of time. Blocks and the runner take an instead of calling UnityEngine.Time or System.DateTime.UtcNow directly.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Platform.OperationFailure
files.Summary: Every failure a service call can produce, classified once by the gateway so that no script and no block ever sees an exception type. See AGENTS.md section 9.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Platform.UnityTimeSource
files.Summary: The time source a running game uses: Unity's own frame clock, read once per call from UnityEngine.Time, with Unity's Time.timeScale as the game's time scale.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Platform.XorshiftRandomSource
files.Summary: The runtime : an explicit-state xorshift32 generator whose sequence is a function of its seed alone.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.PlayerInputFactory
files.Summary: What Input.ForPlayer(player) returns: one method per kind of value an action produces, each declaring one action and handing back the typed handle that reads it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Prefab
files.Summary: A handle to one prefab input of a script. Returned by Bind.Prefab at build time; what the input holds is an instance read, because the value belongs to the object and not to the script type.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Process
files.Summary: Whether a script ticks while the runner is paused, and whether it ticks at all.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ProcessOverride
files.Summary: The Inspector override of on one LunyScriptBehaviour.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomChoiceBuilder
files.Summary: What Random.Choice returns. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomChoiceFromBuilder
files.Summary: A choice that has named its stream. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomFactory
files.Summary: The Random surface inside Build(): named streams and draws that store a result. A draw consumes one sample when the block runs; later reads of the result reuse it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomIndexBuilder
files.Summary: What Random.Index() returns. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomIndexCountBuilder
files.Summary: An index draw that has named its count. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomIndexFromBuilder
files.Summary: An index draw that has named its stream. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomNumberBuilder
files.Summary: What Random.Number() returns. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomNumberFromBuilder
files.Summary: A number draw that has named its stream. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomNumberRangeBuilder
files.Summary: A number draw that has named its range. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomStream
files.Summary: A named random stream declared inside Build(). Mutable state lives on the instance; this handle is an index, the same way a variable handle is.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomStreamSlot
files.Summary: Where one named random stream's state lives on every instance of a program.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomWeightedBuilder
files.Summary: What Random.Weighted returns. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomWeightedFromBuilder
files.Summary: A weighted choice that has named its stream. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RandomWeightedWeightsBuilder
files.Summary: A weighted choice that has its weights. Incomplete until .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ReleaseGate
files.Summary: Gate 4. Runs inside a standalone player built without DEBUG and asserts what only that build can show: that operator true and operator false on a condition block still throw, that the [Conditional] contract guards are gone, and that the two guards written out unconditionally are not.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ReparentBuilder
files.Summary: What SetParent(...) and Unparent() return: the reparent, which keeps the object's world placement unless says otherwise.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ResourcesAssetLoadProvider
files.Summary: The Resources backend for Asset.Load of an AssetSource.Resources key. The read happens inside the provider call, which is a start boundary, and the gateway observes the completed operation on its next poll. Blocks never name UnityEngine.Resources.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Rotation
files.Summary: An orientation in three dimensions, held as a unit quaternion.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RotationSlot
files.Summary: Where one Rotation variable lives on every instance of a program. Allocated at build time and never at run time.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RotationUnary
files.Summary: Which orientation a makes out of one.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RotationValueBlock
files.Summary: The root of every orientation expression: something that produces a when the block holding it runs.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RoundingMode
files.Summary: How Math.Round and Var<Number>.Round resolve a value exactly halfway between two whole numbers.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RoutineBuilder
files.Summary: What Routine(name) returns. Its one call, , takes the steps the routine runs in order and produces the block that starts an activation of it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RoutineGroupBuilder
files.Summary: What InParallel(...) returns: a concurrent group with no ending clause yet.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RoutineGroupEndingBuilder
files.Summary: A concurrent group that carries an early-ending clause. Its one further call decides what happens to the children that had not finished when the group published its result.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RoutineGroupSurvivorBuilder
files.Summary: A concurrent group whose unfinished children the enclosing routine activation owns after the group publishes its result. The routine advances those children during its following steps and cancels them when that routine activation ends or is cancelled.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RunCadenceBuilder
files.Summary: A cadence that has named its unit. runs it indefinitely; adds a duration or count bound.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RunEveryAmountBuilder
files.Summary: A Run(body).Every(amount) chain. Incomplete until a unit.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RunForAmountBuilder
files.Summary: A Run(body).For(amount) chain. Incomplete until a unit or Times.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RunHandle
files.Summary: A finished Run chain. starts or restarts one activation; interrupts it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RunWorkBuilder
files.Summary: What Run(body) returns. Qualifiers name a duration, a cadence, or a repetition count; starts one activation and interrupts it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.RunnerDiagnostics
files.Summary: Native diagnostics for one explicitly supplied local runner. Reads execute no authored logic.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Script
files.Summary: The runtime entry: a subclass whose Build() composes blocks that run on a game object. Editor workflows subclass instead.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ScriptBase
files.Summary: Shared infrastructure for and . One instance of a concrete subclass is compiled into one , once, and every object running that script shares it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ScriptBuildContext
files.Summary: The state one Build() accumulates: the slots its variables declared and the blocks its event registrations produced. Exists for the duration of one build and is then turned into an immutable .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ScriptContexts
files.Summary: Execution contexts a node or service supports.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ScriptInstance
files.Summary: One object's state for one program: the slot arrays the program's layout asked for, and the host the blocks act on. The blocks themselves are shared by every instance of the program and hold no per-object state at all.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ScriptProgram
files.Summary: One script type, built. Holds the immutable block tree, the On.* event table and the instance layout, and is shared by every object running that script.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ScriptRunner
files.Summary: Owns the built programs, the live instances and the instance pool, and runs each event kind across every instance.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.ScriptServices
files.Summary: Services required by composed nodes, independently of their execution contexts.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Services.UgsCloudSaveProvider
files.Summary: The Unity Gaming Services Cloud Save backend: initialises the services, signs in anonymously, and saves and loads player data, all behind so the gateway polls and nothing awaits; AGENTS.md rule 51.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SessionState
files.Summary: What a session is doing. Read through Net.IsConnected and reported by .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SharedFactory
files.Summary: The Shared surface inside Build(): operations on a shared store rather than on one variable.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SharedStore
files.Summary: The identity of one shared-variable store: the default store, or a named one such as the current level.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SlotKind
files.Summary: Which kind of slot a variable occupies. A slot kind is one array on , so adding a kind is adding an array, a layout counter and a branch, and nothing else.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SourceLocation
files.Summary: Where in a user's script a block was authored: the file and the line of the Build() call that created it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SpacedMotionDisplacementBuilder
files.Summary: A Motion displacement whose frame has been named. It converts to a block and takes no further clause.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SpacedMotionForceBuilder
files.Summary: A force or impulse whose frame has been named.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SpacedMotionVelocityBuilder
files.Summary: A velocity whose frame has been named.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SpacedTransformOffsetBuilder
files.Summary: A displacement whose frame has been named. It converts to a block and takes no further clause.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SpawnBuilder
files.Summary: What Object.Spawn(prefab) returns: a spawn with no placement yet. Add , and in any order, or use it as a block, which spawns the prefab at its own pose.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SpawnFramedBuilder
files.Summary: What a frame modifier returns: a spawn whose placement and frame are both stated. It offers no second frame clause, which is what makes a conflicting pair uncompilable.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SpawnObjectBlock
files.Summary: What Object.Spawn(prefab) and its chain build: produces an object from a declared prefab input, places it, parents it, and holds it in an owned-object slot when the chain named one.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SpawnPlacedBuilder
files.Summary: What Object.Spawn(prefab).At(...) returns: a spawn whose placement is stated and whose frame is still the default, the parent's.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SpawnPlacement
files.Summary: Where an authored Object.Spawn puts the object it produces, and in which frame those coordinates are read.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SpawnRequest
files.Summary: One authored Object.Spawn that has run and has not been applied yet: which prefab input to produce from, where the produced object goes, what it is parented to, and which owned-object slot holds it.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SyncCadence
files.Summary: How often one synchronised variable is sent. Declared per variable, because AGENTS.md rule 46 says synchronised state is declared one variable at a time and there is no networked struct and no state object to put two variables into.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SyncDeclaration
files.Summary: One synchronised variable, as the script declared it: which slot holds it, how often it is sent, and the bookkeeping slots the cadence and the staleness reading need. Recorded at build time, read by the program, and never changed afterwards.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SyncFactory
files.Summary: The Sync surface: which parts of an object's transform cross the network, and how often each one is sent.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.SyncKind
files.Summary: The three kinds of cadence. A rate cap is a property of rather than a fourth kind, because a capped and an uncapped OnChange send on the same condition and differ only in how often.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Text
files.Summary: A text literal written in a script, and the type argument that makes a text variable Var<Text>.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TextArgument
files.Summary: One value a Text.Format call fills a hole with. Numbers, flags, text variables and literals of those kinds all convert to it, so a call site writes the value and never this type's name.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TextArgumentKind
files.Summary: Which kind of value one carries.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TextCapacities
files.Summary: Facts about that both the layout and the blocks need.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TextCapacity
files.Summary: How many bytes a text variable can hold. Declared per variable at build time, because the five capacities are five distinct Unity.Collections.FixedString types and a text variable is stored in exactly one of them.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TextDefineBuilder
files.Summary: What Define.Text(name) returns: a 64-byte fixed slot unless Allocating is called.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TextFormat
files.Summary: A parsed Text.Format call: the literal pieces of the format, which value fills each hole, and how many decimal places each number hole asks for. Pass it to a text variable's Set.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TextLength
files.Summary: Named byte bounds for each Text entry in a list or map. Declared per collection side at build time, because the five sizes are five distinct Unity.Collections.FixedString types and every entry on that side uses exactly one of them.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TextLengths
files.Summary: Facts about that collection storage needs.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TextSlot
files.Summary: Where one text variable lives on every instance of a program, and how many bytes it holds. The capacity is part of the handle because each capacity is a separate array on the instance.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TimeFactory
files.Summary: The Time surface a script reads the game clock through, and the one place a script changes how fast that clock runs: , , , , , and .

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TimeReadBlock
files.Summary: What Time.Delta and Time.Elapsed return: a number expression reading one of the runner's two clocks, and the one place the clock choice is written.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TransformAxis
files.Summary: Which component of a transform value a read produces.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TransformChannel
files.Summary: Which part of an object's transform a declaration synchronises. One channel is one declaration with one cadence, which is AGENTS.md rule 46 applied to the transform: a scale that never changes cannot share a payload with a position that changes every tick.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TransformFactory
files.Summary: The Transform surface inside Build(): where the object a script runs on is, how it is turned and scaled, what is above and below it in the hierarchy, and what it is parented to.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TransformOffsetBuilder
files.Summary: What MoveBy and RotateBy return: the displacement, in the object's own frame unless a modifier says otherwise.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TransformPart
files.Summary: Which of the three values of a transform a verb reads or writes.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TransformRelation
files.Summary: Which object a transform verb acts on, named relative to the object the script runs on.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TransformSpace
files.Summary: Which frame a transform verb's numbers are in.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TransformStreamInbox
files.Summary: Holds the transform streams that arrived since the last tick drained them, in one buffer the inbox owns. Every uses one, so that the receive side of the stream is written once rather than once per backend.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TransformSyncDeclaration
files.Summary: One Sync.Position, Sync.Rotation or Sync.Scale as the build recorded it: which channel, at which cadence, and which slots hold the per-object bookkeeping the network tick needs. Built by and read by ; a script never sees one.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TransformTargetFactory
files.Summary: One step of the hierarchy around the object a script runs on: what Transform.Parent, Transform.Child(n) and Transform.Root return.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.TransformToBuilder
files.Summary: What MoveTo, RotateTo and ScaleTo return: the destination, waiting for the duration.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.UIGateway
files.Summary: The core's one entry point to UI Toolkit. Resolves declared names to VisualElement once per instance at spawn and again on panel reload, and answers the writes, reads and occurrence tests the UI blocks make.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.UiActivatedWatchBuilder
files.Summary: What When.UI(button) returns. Activated is pointer click plus keyboard and gamepad submit.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.UiButton
files.Summary: A handle to one named Button.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.UiGroup
files.Summary: A handle to one named Group, for showing or hiding a cluster already in the panel UXML. Not a Place target.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.UiLabel
files.Summary: A handle to one named Label. Returned by Panel.Label at build time.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.UiPlacement
files.Summary: A Place fragment: the name scope for elements inside a cloned UXML, and a block so On.Ready(Panel.Place(...).At(...)) still compiles. Placement itself runs at spawn.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.UiProgressBar
files.Summary: A handle to one named ProgressBar.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.UiText
files.Summary: The current text of a Label or TextField, for PlayerName.Set(nameField.Text).

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.UiTextField
files.Summary: A handle to one named TextField.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.UiToggle
files.Summary: A handle to one named Toggle.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.UiValueChangedWatchBuilder
files.Summary: What When.UI(toggle), When.UI(bar) and When.UI(field) return.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.UtilityOption
files.Summary: One scored option of a Choose selector: a score expression and the action that runs while that option is selected.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.UtilityOptionBuilder
files.Summary: What Option(score) returns. Its one call, , names the action that runs while this option is selected.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Var<T>
files.Summary: A handle to one variable of a script. Returned by Var.Define at build time; the operators and methods on it build blocks.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.VarFactory
files.Summary: The Var surface inside Build(): declares a script's variables and hands back the typed handles the blocks are built from.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.VarWatchBuilder<T>
files.Summary: What When.Var(x) returns. Its only method is , which registers the watch with the build.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.VariableAttribute
files.Summary: Declares a variable whose handle is assigned before Build, in declaration order.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vec2
files.Summary: A two-component spatial value: a stick deflection, a screen offset, a planar direction.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vec2Arithmetic
files.Summary: Which combination a makes of two values.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vec2Component
files.Summary: Which component a replaces.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vec2Scalar
files.Summary: Which number a takes out of one or two values.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vec2Slot
files.Summary: Where one Vec2 variable lives on every instance of a program. Allocated at build time and never at run time.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vec2Unary
files.Summary: Which spatial value a makes out of one.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vec2ValueBlock
files.Summary: The root of every two-component spatial expression: something that produces a when the block holding it runs.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vec3
files.Summary: A three-component spatial value: a position, a direction, a displacement or a scale.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vec3Arithmetic
files.Summary: Which combination a makes of two spatial values.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vec3Component
files.Summary: Which component a replaces.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vec3Scalar
files.Summary: Which number a takes out of one or two spatial values.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vec3Slot
files.Summary: Where one Vec3 variable lives on every instance of a program. Allocated at build time and never at run time.

files.Title: CodeSmile.LunyScript.Vec3Unary
